verdict.rationale: Persona documents Cases, a configurable operations-team UI with SLAs, resolution analytics and automations. Its webhooks expose a 'requires further review' status, so a first-party manual review queue exists. The evidence does not show what reviewers see inside a case or how their decisions are written back. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that cases surface document images, extracted fields and check results together; documented write-back of reviewer approve/decline decisions to the inquiry/account record; independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an ops lead, borderline verifications land in a manual review queue with the full evidence — document images, extracted fields, check results — and reviewer decisions feed back into the record

citations.quote: Cases includes a configurable UI for the operations team, built-in analytics (e.g. SLAs and case resolution rates), the ability create automations, and many other features
Set up webhooks to receive real-time status updates when a user is approved, declined, or requires further review.
A Persona account groups together all information you've collected from an individual user (a single person or business), and lets you view their entire history on Persona in one place.
